Is it really free?
Yes. Every game on the site is free to play, and there is nothing to buy. Short ads inside the games pay the developers and the site.
Do I need to make an account?
No. There is no account, no sign-up and no newsletter. You open a game and play.
Do I have to download or install anything?
No. The games are browser games, so they start instantly with no download and no installs.
Can I play on my phone or tablet?

Yes, for many games. Lots of them are made for touch and collected in the Mobile category, and games built for a wide screen will ask you to turn your phone sideways. A few older games need a keyboard and mouse, and they say so on their page.
Is it safe for my kids?
The site only allows family-friendly games: no adult content, no gambling and no hate. Games for younger players are collected in the Kids category.
Will my progress be saved?

Yes, but only in your own browser. Recently played games, favourites, the light or dark choice and most games' own progress stay on your device and never leave it, so clearing your browser data or playing in private mode will lose them.
A game will not load. What can I do?
If it still will not start, email us at contact@ilovewebgames.com and tell us which game it is, so we can look into it.
Where do the games come from?

Six games are made by Door 404, the studio behind the site. The rest are licensed from the networks Playgama, GameMonetize and GamePix, or sent in directly by 11 independent developers. We never copy games from other portals.
I made a game. Can I submit it?

Yes, it is free and non-exclusive, and you can send it at https://ilovewebgames.com/submit-game/. A real person plays every submission, and an accepted game gets its own page that credits you and links back to you.
How do I get my game removed?
Email us at contact@ilovewebgames.com and we will take it down. Your game stays hosted on your own server, and you can ask for removal at any time.
Can I embed a game on my own website?

You can embed the games made by Door 404. Each of them has an "Embed this game" box with ready-made code on its page. Games from other developers are not ours to licence, so they cannot be embedded this way.
How do I reach a real person?
Write to contact@ilovewebgames.com. The site is run by Door 404, an escape room and game studio from Novi Sad, Serbia.
